intro: Playful abstract paintings, where each composition is a colourful fingerprint of what has been let go of in the process. Texture, layers, and gesture trace the quiet process of inner transformation.
description: Explore the abstract paintings of Toronto artist Carla Gusek. Browse her portfolio and enquire about available artwork.
about_text: Carla Gusek follows an intuitive process of applying colour, texture, and technique to create exploratory abstract paintings inviting viewers to connect with their own unconscious processes.
